baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from ظن السوء through دائرة السوء to غضب, لعن, أعد, and مصيرا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse converts an unreliable forecast into a staged recoil. Thought supplies the projected outcome, the evil circuit closes that outcome around its projectors, and the following verbs move through punitive opposition, expulsion, preparation, and terminal arrival.

activation_trace.role: Painful punishment supplies the governing action whose internal stages the rest of the verse unfolds.
An outcome whose sequel cannot be trusted makes the agents' forecast the unstable first link.
What causes distress recurs as the thought's content, the circuit's quality, and the final destination's evaluation.
The hated turn or defeat gives the forecast a recoiling, enclosing event-form.
Intensified displeasure oriented toward requital supplies the relational breach behind the sequence.
Expulsion under displeasure turns opposition into removal from protected relation.
Readied equipment makes the consequence prepared rather than improvised.
Becoming toward an outcome closes the chain at an attained end rather than a passing episode.

changed_reading.before: A list of condemned groups followed by a list of separate penalties.
changed_reading.after: A bad forecast recoils as an enclosing defeat and advances through opposition, expulsion, and prepared consequence to its own destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired plurals المنافقين والمنافقات and المشركين والمشركات, jointly governed by الظانين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two named alignments can be read as distinct architectures of failed relation. One displays an entrance while concealing an exit; the other catches by a binding association. The shared participle makes both architectures issue in the same accusatory projection toward God.

activation_trace.role: A shown door with a concealed exit models hypocrisy as an asymmetry between declared entry and hidden departure.
The hunter's snare models wrongful association as a bond that captures rather than sustains.
Suspicion or accusation supplies the common outward act produced by both relational architectures.

changed_reading.before: Hypocrites and polytheists are merely two doctrinal categories receiving the same fate.
changed_reading.after: They instantiate two coexisting failure mechanisms, covert exit and captor-association, which converge in projecting an accusation onto God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ظن, doubled nominal السوء, spatial عليهم, دائرة, and مصيرا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse spatializes cognition. A supposition marks where an outcome is expected, the circular construction gives that expectation a boundary, and the destination gives it an inhabited terminus. The reversal is rhetorical and judicial: the speakers do not magically create fate, but their false map is turned back into the map of their own end.

activation_trace.role: The expected place of a thing lets supposition function as an attempted location of where evil will be found.
Circularity and surrounding give the attempted forecast a bounded spatial geometry.
Badness labels the projected content, the enclosing condition, and the terminal assessment across the map.
A place of settlement converts an abstract outcome into the location finally occupied.

changed_reading.before: Bad thought is only an incorrect theological opinion.
changed_reading.after: Bad thought is also a false topography of the future: it locates evil around divine action, then the verse relocates its speakers inside that geometry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يعذب, لعنهم, أعد لهم جهنم, and مصيرا as a sequence of altered access and location.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-distant but coherent sequence reads punishment as more than inflicted pain: access is withheld, the subjects are expelled from relation, and a destination is made ready as their fixed place. This remains a secondary material-social reading alongside the ordinary punitive sense.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and weaning supply deprivation as a secondary texture of punishment.
Expulsion supplies the boundary-crossing from failed relation to exclusion.
Preparation makes the terminal location available before arrival.
A settled place gives exclusion a fixed endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is exhausted by the image of pain.
changed_reading.after: Punishment also has a relational and spatial mechanism: deprivation, expulsion, and emplacement in a readied end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope opens with a closed space being opened, while the focus gives the hostile forecast a circle that closes around its makers. The opposed motions recast the focus as a counter-forecast: what they treated as a doomed closure is already being opened, and their closed projection becomes their own defeat.

activation_trace.role: The opening and widening of a closed entrance supplies the pericope's initial counter-motion.
Circular enclosure supplies the hostile forecast's opposed geometry.
An untrustworthy sequel identifies the circle as their attempted forecast of how events will end.

structural_cues: 48:1 announces فتح before 48:6 presents the nominal construction عليهم دائرة السوء.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening and enclosing motions; I infer that the first overturns the agents' closed forecast. A live alternative is that فتح is primarily adjudication or victory rather than geometry, but that sense still counters their projected outcome.

changed_reading.before: The evil circuit is a free-standing image of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The circuit is the recoiling closure of a forecast already contradicted by the pericope's opening act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent purpose clauses distribute opposed motions across parallel gender-paired groups. Believing men and women are brought inside a sheltered, flowing, enduring space and their evils are covered away; the focus's groups encounter evil circling upon them, expulsion, and a bad settled end. The focus is therefore the negative half of a deliberately mirrored allocation, not an isolated curse catalog.

activation_trace.role: Entry to an interior supplies the positive motion opposed to curse as expulsion.
The tree-sheltered garden supplies the protected interior into which the believers enter.
Unimpeded flow gives the positive destination an open, sustaining circulation.
Durable remaining supplies the positive endpoint's stability.
Covering away an offense supplies the removal of evils from them, opposite evil's return upon the focus groups.
Distressing evil remains attached to thought, circuit, and destination rather than being covered away.
Expulsion supplies the negative motion opposed to entry.
A settled destination completes the negative side of the allocation.

structural_cues: 48:5 and 48:6 are adjacent coordinated purpose clauses; both enumerate masculine and feminine groups, while 48:5 repeats عنهم and 48:6 repeats عليهم and لهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies syntactic coordination, paired populations, and opposite spatial motions; I infer a mirrored distributive design. A live alternative is that the clauses simply enumerate independent outcomes, though the repeated gender and pronoun patterns still make them mutually clarifying.

changed_reading.before: 48:6 independently accumulates punishments for several groups.
changed_reading.after: 48:6 is the negative allocation in a paired destiny structure: covered evil and protected entry on one side, returning evil and expulsion on the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later covenant formula states the feedback arrow explicitly: whoever undoes a bound commitment undoes it only upon the self. That reflexive rule sharpens عليهم دائرة السوء into covenantal recoil. The circuit is not arbitrary impact from outside; it is the returned consequence of breaking a relation one had outwardly entered.

activation_trace.role: Undoing a covenant after its binding supplies the breach that generates recoil.
The very self identifies the returned consequence's destination.
A preserved compact supplies the relation whose maintenance or undoing has consequences.
The hated returning turn gives breach its enclosing consequence in the focus.

structural_cues: 48:10 says فمن نكث فإنما ينكث على نفسه; 48:6 locates the evil circuit عليهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit breach-to-self formula and the focus's upon-them circuit; I carry that directional arrow back into 48:6. A live alternative is that 48:10 limits the reflexive rule to the pledge, while 48:6 addresses broader forms of failed allegiance.

changed_reading.before: The circuit falls on them as an unexplained external sentence.
changed_reading.after: The circuit is also reflexive covenantal consequence: concealed or wrongful allegiance returns its breach upon the breacher.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mouth-heart mismatch in 48:11 gives the focus's hidden-exit branch a concrete communicative layout. Speech is the visible doorway; the heart contains a different route. Hypocrisy is thus not merely private doubt but a designed divergence between public utterance and interior commitment.

activation_trace.role: Emitted speech supplies the publicly accessible entrance of the mismatch.
The speaking organ localizes the exterior channel.
The heart supplies the concealed interior whose content diverges from the exterior channel.
Showing one door while hiding an exit converts the speech-heart split into the focus category's mechanism.

structural_cues: 48:11 explicitly contrasts what they say with their tongues and what is not in their hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exterior-interior speech contrast and a focus branch with shown entrance and hidden exit; I identify them as the same social mechanism. A live alternative is that 48:11 illustrates one local species of hypocrisy rather than exhausting the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: The hypocrites are named without showing how hypocrisy operates.
changed_reading.after: Their operation becomes architectural: a public verbal entrance masks an interior route of departure.

context_deltas.mechanism: 48:12 repeats the focus phrase and supplies its concrete forecast: the messenger and believers will never turn back to their families. That forecast is beautified in the heart, then the forecasters themselves are called ruined. The focus's circuit can now be read as a return-reversal: those who predict no return for the faithful receive the bad turn upon themselves.

activation_trace.role: An untrustworthy outcome supplies the specific forecast of permanent non-return and explicitly repeats the bad thought.
Turning back or reaching a destination activates the return they deny and the reversal the focus imposes.
The heart locates the embellished forecast in an interior commitment rather than a passing verbal guess.
Making something appear good explains why the failed forecast persists attractively in the heart.
Ruin and corruption transfer the forecasted failure from the believers' journey to the forecasters' own state.
The turning of conditions supplies the reversal by which the forecast changes owners.

structural_cues: 48:12 repeats ظننتم ظن السوء and places permanent non-return immediately before that repeated phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies the bad thought's local content; I infer that 48:12 retrospectively specifies 48:6 and that the circuit reverses that forecast onto its makers. A live alternative is that the focus phrase also includes a broader low estimate of divine agency beyond this one prediction.

changed_reading.before: Thinking badly of God is a generic hostile opinion.
changed_reading.after: It is concretely the attractive but unreliable prediction that the faithful will not return, a prediction whose non-return and ruin recoil upon its holders.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated preparation formula in 48:13, including the split mapping of ع ت د to both readiness and the focus's ع د د inventory, makes the fire a present, provisioned consequence. This separates divine anger from improvisational heat: anger names settled opposition, while the destination is already readied.

activation_trace.role: Preparation of equipment cross-maps the later formula to the focus's own readiness branch.
Something present and made ready supplies a second, non-collapsed branch of preparedness.
Kindled fire identifies what the later preparation makes available.
Readied equipment gives the focus's أعد its provisioned rather than spontaneous force.
Requital-oriented displeasure is distinguished from the already prepared instrument of consequence.

structural_cues: 48:6 says أعد لهم جهنم and 48:13 says أعتدنا للكافرين سعيرا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated preparation formula, a split root mapping, and kindled fire; I infer that readiness precedes rather than erupts from anger. A live alternative is that the repetition is formulaic emphasis without an intended temporal distinction.

changed_reading.before: Anger appears to trigger an improvised punitive reaction.
changed_reading.after: Anger marks stable opposition within an already provisioned order of consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: 48:21 presents an unattained possibility already encompassed by God and pairs human incapacity with divine capacity. This nests the focus's evil circle inside a greater enclosure: the hostile forecast mistakes its own inability to reach or see an outcome for the limit of what can occur.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity distinguishes the humans' unattained possibility from divine power over it.
Physical surrounding supplies the larger enclosure within which the unseen outcome is already held.
The untrustworthy sequel marks the focus groups' error in treating inaccessible outcome as settled failure.
Their evil circle becomes a smaller, recoiling enclosure inside divine encompassing.

structural_cues: 48:21 juxtaposes لم تقدروا عليها with قد أحاط الله بها; 48:6 juxtaposes their forecast with a circle upon them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incapacity, divine encompassing, and the focus circle; I infer nested scopes in which limited access is mistaken for closed reality. A live alternative is that divine encompassing denotes control or knowledge without a deliberate spatial answer to دائرة.

changed_reading.before: Their bad thought is wrong only because its predicted event fails.
changed_reading.after: Their bad thought is an epistemic scale error: they make their limited reach the boundary of reality, while the unseen is held in a larger divine enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: 48:25 withholds punishment because unknown believing men and women are intermingled with the opposing population, then makes punishment conditional on separation. This constrains the focus's broad plurals: they name divinely discerned stances, not an indiscriminate permission to treat a mixed population as one block.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower marks the hidden identities that human actors cannot safely sort.
Severe trampling pressure supplies the collateral harm prevented while identities remain mixed.
Operational separation and distinction supply the stated condition before punishment.
The second mapped inventory independently reinforces categorical differentiation without collapsing the split root.
Painful punishment is explicitly placed after the unrealized condition of separation.
The focus's governing punishment is constrained by the later scene's discrimination rule.

structural_cues: 48:25 names unknown believing men and women within the opposed population and states لو تزيلوا لعذبنا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed intermixture, prevented collateral pressure, and an explicit separation-before-punishment conditional; I use it to constrain application of 48:6's plural labels. A live alternative is that the restraint is specific to this historical encounter, though it still blocks an indiscriminate reading of the local discourse.

changed_reading.before: The plural categories can be heard as authorizing undifferentiated collective punishment.
changed_reading.after: The categories are exact at divine resolution but not available for indiscriminate human application; hidden intermixture must be differentiated before punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later affective distribution separates heated pride lodged in hostile hearts, tranquility descending on the faithful, protective restraint, and constricted rage produced in opponents. Against that field, the focus's divine غضب reads less like uncontrolled heat and more like knowledgeable, requital-oriented opposition.

activation_trace.role: Pride and anger in the heart localize reactive heat on the human side of the contrast.
Cessation of agitation supplies the opposed affective motion sent upon the faithful.
Protective prevention supplies disciplined restraint rather than reactive escalation.
Constricted rage held in the chest places frustrated affect in the disbelieving observers.
Displeasure directed to requital supplies a judicial-relational sense distinct from heated pride or frustrated rage.

structural_cues: 48:26 places حمية in hostile hearts but sends سكينة upon the messenger and believers; 48:29 makes those believers a cause of غيظ in disbelievers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct affective roots and allocates them to different agents; I infer that the contrasts qualify غضب as principled opposition rather than loss of composure. A live alternative is that the lexical fields coexist without a designed contrast, so the theological qualification remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: Divine anger is easily pictured as the same heated affect displayed by human opponents.
changed_reading.after: Divine anger functions as knowledgeable requital within a field that assigns reactive heat and constricted rage to human agents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the governing form conventionally activates punishment, not hydraulics. It remains anchored in the packet's sweetness, withholding, tunnel, circulation, and flowing-river branches. Render it only as a material analogy for deprivation and blocked passage, never as a replacement lexical gloss for يعذب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يعذب beside the hidden-exit نفق image and the circulating دائرة, contrasted with the flowing destination in 48:5.

activation_trace.role: Drinkable sweetness supplies the sustaining medium whose loss can be felt as deprivation.
Withholding supplies the blocking action in the material analogy.
A through-tunnel with an outlet supplies the conduit expected to provide escape or passage.
Circulation supplies the loop that ceases to be an escape route and closes around its users.
Free flow in the adjacent positive destination activates the contrast with withheld or trapped circulation.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an externally inflicted pain with no material process.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, punishment is loss of sustaining flow: a hidden conduit fails as escape, circulation closes, while the opposed destination continues to run.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The enclosure image is branch-distant because مصير ordinarily marks outcome and the verse does not lexically call hell a livestock pen. It remains anchored by expulsion, preparation, destination, and the packet's enclosure branch. Downstream prose should say the sequence behaves like exile into a prepared holding-space, not identify جهنم with that branch image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لعنهم, أعد لهم, جهنم, and مصيرا as a spatial progression wholly inside 48:6.

activation_trace.role: Expulsion initiates movement beyond a protected boundary.
Preparation supplies a destination made ready to receive the expelled.
The livestock enclosure supplies a contained endpoint as a material analogy for the destination.

changed_reading.before: Curse, preparation, and destination are independent abstract punishments.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form one spatial operation: expulsion from relation followed by collection in a readied enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it lets the closing crop mechanics illuminate social labels in the focus. It remains anchored in نفق and شرك and in the packet's explicit offshoot, mutual support, thickening, and standing sequence. Render it as a contrastive social morphology, not an etymological definition of hypocrisy or polytheism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's paired social plurals, especially نفق as concealed passage and شرك as association, read against the mutually supporting growth of 48:29.

activation_trace.role: A private through-route supplies a network organized around covert exit.
Association supplies linkage whose quality can be contrasted with the crop's sustaining mutuality.
An offshoot emerging around its origin supplies visible lateral growth rather than concealed departure.
Plants strengthening one another supplies the constructive form of association.
Thickening after thinness supplies resilience produced by mutual support.
Rising and settling upon support supplies the stable posture achieved by the constructive network.

changed_reading.before: The focus groups are static labels detached from the surah's final social image.
changed_reading.after: They can be carried as failed network morphologies: covert exits and corrupt association oppose a community whose visible offshoots support, thicken, and stand.

strongest_changes: The adjacent gender-paired purpose clauses make 48:6 the negative half of a destiny allocation: evil is covered away from one population but circles back upon the other.
The explicit breach-upon-self formula in 48:10 gives the evil circuit a reflexive covenantal arrow.
48:12 identifies the bad thought as the embellished forecast that the messenger and believers will never return, allowing the circuit to read as that non-return recoiling on its makers.
48:25 prevents an indiscriminate collective reading by making punishment wait on knowledge and separation within a mixed population.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting geometries rather than one consensus gloss: opening versus closure, protected entry versus expulsion, limited circles nested inside divine encompassing, and hidden exits versus mutually supporting growth. The split ع ت د mapping also made preparedness a live cross-root mechanism instead of collapsing it to one inventory.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening-circle and encompassing-circle correspondences may be deliberate spatial counterpoints or only productive abductive overlays.
The separation rule in 48:25 certainly constrains the local scene, but the extent of its general legal force is not supplied by this packet.
The withheld-flow, prepared-enclosure, and failed-network readings are branch-backed analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.
